generic.Defined scope/population: All named sponsor contacts on the installation case who require portal admin access at orientation
generic.In-scope period: The installation window from sponsor contact list sign-off through the go-live orientation date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each contact has name, email, role and an active portal admin ID with a recorded first-login date
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Portal admin ID count equals the named sponsor contact count on the installation case
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Orientation agenda, attendee list and recording link filed on the case with date and version
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Contacts who did not attend or did not log in are logged with a follow-up session date
generic.Test population: All sponsor portal admin IDs created for the plan plus the recorded orientation attendee list
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires every named sponsor contact to hold an active admin ID with a first-login date
generic.Exception handling path: Failed logins route to the portal access team and a repeat orientation session is scheduled
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when agenda, attendee list, recording link and quick-reference issue are all recorded
generic.Evidence location: Installation case in the workflow tool and the sponsor folder in the document management repository

steps.title: Pull the named sponsor contact list from the installation case in the workflow tool
sop: Open the plan installation case and locate the sponsor service-model contact matrix
Confirm each contact name, title, email and the entitlement profile they need
Flag any contact missing an email or role so the sponsor can confirm before setup
Done when the contact list is confirmed and attached to the installation case
verify: Check every contact row carries a name, email and entitlement profile
Pass when the confirmed contact list is attached to the case with no blank fields

steps.title: Create sponsor portal admin IDs in the Customer Self-Service Portal
sop: Raise a portal admin ID for each named contact using the confirmed entitlement profile
Issue activation links to each contact email from the portal
Record the created ID against each contact row on the installation case
Done when an admin ID exists for every named sponsor contact
verify: Compare the portal admin ID count to the named contact count on the case
Pass when counts match and no unrecognised admin ID exists on the plan

steps.title: Confirm first login by each sponsor contact in the Customer Self-Service Portal
sop: Run the portal admin login report for the plan after activation links are issued
Chase any contact with no login recorded before the orientation date
Record the first-login date against each contact on the installation case
Done when every named contact shows a recorded first-login date
verify: Inspect the login report for contacts with no first-login date
Pass when no named contact remains without a recorded first login

steps.title: Walk the sponsor through payroll upload, funding and reporting screens in the portal
sop: Demonstrate the payroll file upload screen including layout validation and error display
Demonstrate contribution funding instruction entry and the on-demand reporting menu
Answer sponsor questions live and note any follow-up on the installation case
Done when all three portal workflows have been demonstrated to the attendees
verify: Check the agenda records demonstration of upload, funding and reporting screens
Pass when all three workflows are marked demonstrated on the agenda

steps.title: Show the plan document, SPD and fee disclosure vault in the document management repository
sop: Open the sponsor document vault and show where the plan document and SPD are filed
Show the fee disclosure folder and explain the indexing and retrieval convention
Confirm the sponsor contacts can open a document from their own portal session
Done when the sponsor has located a vault document from their own login
verify: Confirm at least one sponsor contact opened a vault document during the session
Pass when the vault walkthrough is recorded on the orientation agenda

steps.title: Record orientation date, attendees and recording link on the installation case
sop: Attach the agenda, attendee list and session recording link to the installation case
Record the orientation date and the facilitator name on the case
Log any contact who did not attend with a follow-up session date
Done when the orientation evidence pack is attached to the case
verify: Open the case and confirm agenda, attendee list and recording link are attached
Pass when all three artefacts are present with the orientation date recorded

steps.title: Issue the quick-reference guide and contact matrix from the document management repository
sop: Generate the sponsor quick-reference guide and the service-model contact matrix
Send both to every named contact and post them to the sponsor document vault
Record the issue date and recipient list on the installation case
Done when both documents are issued and posted to the vault
verify: Check the recipient list against the named sponsor contact list
Pass when every named contact received both documents and the vault copy exists

generic.Defined scope/population: All elective plan provisions in the adoption agreement that must be configured on the recordkeeping platform
generic.In-scope period: From plan document receipt to the date the plan is set to ACTIVE on the platform
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Eligibility, entry dates, deferral types, match formula, vesting and loan provisions are all populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Configured provision count equals the elective provision count listed from the adoption agreement
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Plan rules validation report and second-reviewer sign-off retained with run date and version
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every validation exception is logged with its resolution before the plan is set ACTIVE
generic.Test population: All plan rule screens on the recordkeeping platform for the plan being installed
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires zero open configuration exceptions and a recorded second-reviewer sign-off
generic.Exception handling path: Unsupported provisions route back to the plan document review task for an agreed workaround
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the plan status is ACTIVE and the plan rules validation report runs clean
generic.Evidence location: Plan record in the policy administration system and the plan folder in the document repository

steps.title: Extract the elective provision list from the adoption agreement in the document repository
sop: Open the executed adoption agreement in the document management repository
List every elective provision that requires a platform configuration setting
Attach the provision list to the plan installation record
Done when the elective provision list is attached and agreed with the analyst
verify: Compare the provision list to the adoption agreement section by section
Pass when every elective section of the agreement appears on the list

steps.title: Key eligibility and entry-date rules into the plan rules screen
sop: Enter the minimum age, service requirement and hours requirement from the agreement
Set the entry-date rule as immediate, monthly, quarterly or semi-annual as documented
Enter the excluded employment classifications where the plan excludes them
Done when eligibility and entry-date fields are saved on the plan rules screen
verify: Read back the saved eligibility fields against the adoption agreement
Pass when every eligibility and entry field matches the executed agreement

steps.title: Configure deferral types and per-source annual limits on the platform
sop: Enable pre-tax, Roth and catch-up deferral types as permitted by the document
Set the plan minimum and maximum deferral percentages for each type
Set the annual per-source limits used for in-year limit monitoring
Done when every permitted deferral type is enabled with its limits
verify: Check that no deferral type is enabled which the plan document does not permit
Pass when enabled types and limits match the adoption agreement

steps.title: Configure the match formula, vesting schedule and forfeiture treatment
sop: Enter the match rate, tiers and cap and set the true-up flag as documented
Enter the vesting schedule and the service-crediting method
Set the forfeiture treatment used when a partially vested participant is paid out
Done when match, vesting and forfeiture settings are saved on the plan
verify: Recalculate one sample match and one sample vested percentage by hand
Pass when both hand calculations agree with the platform result

steps.title: Enable auto-enrollment defaults and the QDIA fund where the plan has an ACA
sop: Set the default deferral rate, the escalation increment and the escalation cap
Flag the QDIA fund or target-date series used for participants without an election
Confirm the automatic contribution arrangement notice trigger is switched on
Done when auto-enrollment settings are saved or the plan is marked as having no ACA
verify: Confirm exactly one fund or series carries the QDIA flag where an ACA applies
Pass when the escalation cap and default rate match the plan document

steps.title: Run the plan rules validation report and clear every exception
sop: Run the plan rules validation report on the policy administration system
Work each exception to resolution and re-run the report after every correction
Record the cause and resolution of each exception on the installation case
Done when the validation report returns with no open exceptions
verify: Review the final validation run for remaining exception rows
Pass when the report shows zero open configuration exceptions

steps.title: Obtain second-reviewer sign-off and set the plan to ACTIVE
sop: Have a second reviewer compare the configured rules to the adoption agreement
Record the reviewer name, date and any comments on the installation case
Set the plan status to ACTIVE once sign-off is recorded
Done when the plan status is ACTIVE with sign-off recorded
verify: Check the plan header for ACTIVE status and the sign-off entry
Pass when status is ACTIVE and a dated second-reviewer sign-off exists

generic.Defined scope/population: Every fund selected for the plan investment lineup including collective trusts and stable value options
generic.In-scope period: From sponsor lineup selection to the date the lineup is confirmed tradeable before go-live
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each fund has a CUSIP, ticker, confirmed share class and a recorded revenue-sharing rate
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Confirmed fund count equals the fund count on the sponsor-approved lineup
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Platform tradeability extract and share class confirmation retained with the check date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Funds closed to new investors are logged with the sponsor-approved substitute fund
generic.Test population: All funds on the sponsor-approved lineup checked against the platform trading agreement
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires a tradeable CUSIP and confirmed share class for every lineup fund
generic.Exception handling path: Untradeable or closed funds route to the sponsor for a documented substitute selection
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when no closed-to-new-investors fund remains in the active lineup
generic.Evidence location: Lineup check workbook on the plan record and the fund records in the policy administration system

steps.title: Build the lineup check workbook in Microsoft Excel from the sponsor proposal
sop: List every proposed fund with its name, ticker, CUSIP and quoted share class
Add columns for tradeability, availability, revenue share and participation agreement
Attach the workbook to the plan installation record
Done when every proposed fund appears on the check workbook
verify: Compare the workbook row count to the sponsor proposal fund count
Pass when the counts agree and no fund is missing a CUSIP or ticker

steps.title: Confirm each fund CUSIP is tradeable under the platform trading agreement
sop: Query the platform tradeable security list in the data warehouse by CUSIP
Mark each fund tradeable or not tradeable on the check workbook
Raise a request to add any fund not on the trading agreement
Done when every CUSIP carries a tradeability outcome
verify: Filter the workbook for funds with no tradeability outcome
Pass when every lineup fund shows a confirmed tradeable CUSIP

steps.title: Verify the quoted share class matches the class actually available
sop: Compare the share class quoted in the sponsor proposal to the available class
Record any difference such as R6 quoted against R4 available
Notify the sponsor where the available class changes the quoted pricing
Done when the available share class is recorded for every fund
verify: Check each fund row for both the quoted and the available share class
Pass when no fund shows a share class difference left unresolved

steps.title: Check revenue-sharing and 12b-1 rates per share class against the pricing fee schedule
sop: Pull the revenue-sharing and 12b-1 rate for each confirmed share class
Compare each rate to the fee schedule used to price the sponsor proposal
Escalate any rate difference that changes plan pricing to the relationship team
Done when every fund carries a compared revenue-sharing rate
verify: Review the comparison column for funds with no rate recorded
Pass when every fund shows a rate compared to the pricing fee schedule

steps.title: Confirm participation agreements for collective trusts and stable value funds
sop: Identify collective trust and stable-value options on the lineup
Locate the executed participation agreement for each in the plan folder
Chase the sponsor or provider where an agreement is missing
Done when every such fund holds an executed participation agreement
verify: Check each collective trust and stable-value row for an agreement reference
Pass when no such fund remains without an executed agreement

steps.title: Log closed funds and obtain the sponsor-approved substitute
sop: Flag every fund closed to new investors on the check workbook
Send the closed-fund list to the sponsor with the substitute request
Record the sponsor written substitute selection against each closed fund
Done when every closed fund has a sponsor-approved substitute recorded
verify: Filter the final lineup for funds flagged closed to new investors
Pass when no closed-to-new-investors fund remains in the active lineup

steps.title: Publish the confirmed lineup and file the evidence on the plan record
sop: Finalise the workbook showing tradeability, share class and agreement status
Attach the workbook and the platform tradeability extract to the plan record
Notify the installation team that the lineup is confirmed for platform setup
Done when the confirmed lineup and its evidence are filed on the plan record
verify: Open the plan record and confirm the workbook and extract are attached
Pass when both artefacts are attached and dated for the confirmation run

generic.Defined scope/population: All converted participants who must hold portal and telephone account access at plan launch
generic.In-scope period: From the conversion load date through the day participant access is opened
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each participant record carries a valid SSN, date of birth and a portal registration status
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Portal registration record count equals the converted participant count on the platform
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Registration extract and sample login test results retained with the test date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Registration failures are logged with cause and resolution before access is opened
generic.Test population: Three sample participant IDs across different money sources plus the full registration extract
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires sample portal balances to match the recordkeeping system exactly
generic.Exception handling path: Missing SSN, invalid date of birth or duplicate records route to data remediation before opening access
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when no unresolved registration failure remains for converted participants
generic.Evidence location: Access verification case in the workflow tool with the registration extract attached

steps.title: Run the participant registration extract from the policy administration system
sop: Extract every converted participant with their portal registration status
Compare the extract count to the converted participant count on the platform
Attach the extract to the access verification case
Done when the registration extract is produced and attached to the case
verify: Compare extract record count to the converted participant count
Pass when the two counts agree with no missing participants

steps.title: Identify converted participants with no portal record
sop: Filter the extract for participants with no portal registration record
List each with the reason the registration did not create
Route each to the data remediation queue on the case
Done when every participant without a portal record is listed and routed
verify: Review the exception list against the extract
Pass when every participant lacking a portal record has a routed remediation item

steps.title: Test login and balance display with three sample participant IDs in the portal
sop: Select three participants holding different money sources including a loan
Log in through the Customer Self-Service Portal test path for each
Compare the displayed balance by source to the policy administration system
Done when all three sample logins are tested and results recorded
verify: Compare each sample portal balance to the recordkeeping account screen
Pass when all three sample balances match the recordkeeping system

steps.title: Confirm multi-factor authentication prompts on first login in the portal
sop: Trigger a first-login session for a sample participant ID
Confirm the multi-factor enrollment prompt appears and completes
Record the outcome and any prompt failure on the case
Done when the multi-factor prompt is confirmed on first login
verify: Check the case for the recorded multi-factor test outcome
Pass when the enrollment prompt appeared and completed for the sample

steps.title: Verify interactive voice response authentication for the same sample IDs
sop: Call the interactive voice response line for each sample participant ID
Confirm authentication succeeds and the quoted balance matches the platform
Record the outcome for each sample on the access verification case
Done when all sample IDs authenticate on the voice channel
verify: Compare voice-quoted balances to the recordkeeping account screen
Pass when every sample authenticates and the quoted balance agrees

steps.title: Resolve registration failures before opening participant access
sop: Work each registration failure for missing SSN, invalid date of birth or duplicates
Correct the source record and re-run the registration for that participant
Record the cause and resolution against each failure on the case
Done when every registration failure is resolved and re-run
verify: Re-run the registration extract and filter for remaining failures
Pass when no unresolved registration failure remains for converted participants

steps.title: Confirm access opening and file evidence on the workflow case
sop: Confirm portal and voice access are enabled for the converted population
Attach the final registration extract and sample test results to the case
Notify the installation team that participant access is verified
Done when access is opened and the evidence pack is attached
verify: Open the case and check for the extract and the sample test results
Pass when both are attached with the verification date recorded

generic.Defined scope/population: Every ERISA notice required at launch by the plan features including SPD, 404(a)(5), QDIA and blackout
generic.In-scope period: The statutory notice windows measured relative to the plan effective date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each notice carries a distribution date, delivery method and recipient count
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Distribution count for each notice equals the eligible participant count on the census
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Mail vendor delivery file and e-delivery consent list retained with distribution dates
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Participants with no valid address or e-delivery consent are logged and routed to remediation
generic.Test population: All required launch notices for the plan and their recorded distribution files
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires a dated delivery file for every required launch notice
generic.Exception handling path: Undelivered or missing notices route to the re-issue process with a target date
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when no required notice remains in NOT DISTRIBUTED status
generic.Evidence location: Compliance evidence repository indexed by plan, plan year and notice type

steps.title: Build the launch notice checklist from the plan features in the workflow tool
sop: List the plan features that trigger a notice such as ACA, QDIA and blackout
Derive the required notice set including SPD, 404(a)(5), QDIA and safe-harbor
Attach the checklist to the installation compliance case
Done when the required notice set is listed and attached to the case
verify: Compare the checklist to the configured plan features on the platform
Pass when every feature-triggered notice appears on the checklist

steps.title: Confirm each notice was distributed inside its statutory window
sop: Record the distribution date for each notice from the delivery file
Compare each date to the statutory window relative to the plan effective date
Flag any notice distributed outside its window as an exception
Done when every notice carries a window compliance outcome
verify: Review the window column for notices with no outcome or a late flag
Pass when every notice shows a distribution date inside its statutory window

steps.title: Reconcile distribution counts to the eligible participant census
sop: Pull the eligible participant count from the census used at launch
Compare the recipient count on each notice delivery file to that count
Investigate any shortfall and identify the participants omitted
Done when every notice count is reconciled to the census
verify: Check each notice row for a count difference against the census
Pass when distribution counts equal the eligible participant count per notice

steps.title: File the mail vendor delivery file and e-delivery consent list as evidence
sop: Collect the mail vendor delivery confirmation file for each notice run
Collect the electronic delivery consent list and the bounce report
Index both to the compliance evidence repository by plan year and notice type
Done when delivery evidence is filed for every notice
verify: Search the evidence repository by notice type for the plan year
Pass when a dated delivery file exists for every required launch notice

steps.title: Log participants with no valid address or e-delivery consent
sop: Extract participants with returned mail, no address or no e-delivery consent
Record each on the compliance case with the failure reason
Route each to the address remediation and re-issue process
Done when every failed recipient is logged and routed
verify: Review the exception log for entries without a routed remediation action
Pass when every failed recipient carries a disposition and target date

steps.title: Clear NOT DISTRIBUTED statuses and confirm the launch notice set is complete
sop: Review the notice checklist for any item still in NOT DISTRIBUTED status
Drive each outstanding notice to distribution with the mailing team
Update the checklist status once the delivery file is received
Done when no required notice remains in NOT DISTRIBUTED status
verify: Re-read the notice checklist statuses on the compliance case
Pass when every required launch notice shows a distributed status

steps.title: Record the launch notice confirmation on the compliance evidence repository
sop: Compile the confirmation summary showing each notice, date, count and evidence link
Attach the summary to the compliance evidence repository for the plan year
Notify the installation team that launch notice obligations are confirmed
Done when the confirmation summary is filed and the team notified
verify: Open the filed summary and check each notice has a date and evidence link
Pass when every required notice row is complete on the filed summary

generic.Defined scope/population: Every asset tranche transferring from the prior recordkeeper including cash, in-kind, loans and brokerage
generic.In-scope period: From the prior trustee liquidation schedule date to receipt of the final transfer tranche
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each tranche carries an asset type, trade date, settlement date and expected amount
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Transfer receipts total equals the prior recordkeeper final valuation report total
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Liquidation schedule, wire callback note and receipt confirmations retained with dates
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Tranches not received by the agreed date are logged and escalated to the transition manager
generic.Test population: All asset tranches listed on the prior trustee liquidation schedule
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires receipts to equal the prior recordkeeper final valuation total
generic.Exception handling path: Short or late receipts escalate to the transition manager and the prior recordkeeper same day
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when no transfer tranche remains open past the agreed transfer date
generic.Evidence location: Transition case in the workflow tool with receipts filed against the trust account record

steps.title: Obtain the prior trustee liquidation schedule and load it to the transition case
sop: Request the liquidation schedule listing every asset, trade date and settlement date
Load each tranche onto the transition case as a tracked item
Confirm the expected amount for each tranche with the prior recordkeeper
Done when every asset tranche is tracked on the transition case
verify: Compare the tracked tranche list to the liquidation schedule line by line
Pass when every schedule line appears as a tracked tranche on the case

steps.title: Confirm the receiving trust account and wire instructions by callback
sop: Confirm the receiving trust account number in the general ledger for the plan
Call the prior recordkeeper on a previously known number to confirm wire details
Record the callback date, the person spoken to and the confirmed details
Done when wire instructions are confirmed by an independent callback
verify: Check the case for the callback note with date and contact name
Pass when wire instructions carry a documented independent callback confirmation

steps.title: Track each asset tranche to receipt in the general ledger
sop: Monitor the trust account for incoming cash, in-kind securities and loan notes
Mark each tranche received with the value date and the amount credited
Chase any tranche not received on its scheduled settlement date
Done when every tranche is marked received or flagged outstanding
verify: Review the tranche tracker for items with no receipt status
Pass when every tranche shows a receipt status with a value date

steps.title: Reconcile transferred cash to the prior recordkeeper final valuation report
sop: Sum all cash and in-kind receipts credited to the plan trust account
Compare the total to the prior recordkeeper final valuation report
Investigate and document every difference with the prior recordkeeper
Done when the receipt total is reconciled to the final valuation report
verify: Compare the reconciled receipt total to the final valuation total
Pass when receipts equal the prior recordkeeper final valuation total

steps.title: Reconcile self-directed brokerage and loan note tranches separately
sop: Confirm brokerage account transfers by account and value against the prior register
Confirm loan notes received match the prior loan register principal and interest
Record any tranche transferring on a delayed schedule with its expected date
Done when brokerage and loan tranches are separately reconciled
verify: Compare loan note totals to the prior loan register
Pass when brokerage and loan tranche totals agree to the prior registers

steps.title: Escalate tranches not received by the agreed transfer date
sop: Identify tranches still outstanding after the agreed transfer date
Escalate each to the transition manager with the amount and days late
Record the escalation and the prior recordkeeper commitment on the case
Done when every late tranche carries a recorded escalation
verify: Filter the tracker for outstanding tranches without an escalation entry
Pass when no tranche is open past the agreed date without an escalation

steps.title: Close the transfer coordination and file receipts on the transition case
sop: Attach every receipt confirmation and the reconciliation to the transition case
Record the final transfer completion date and the total received
Notify the installation team that asset transfer is complete
Done when the transfer is closed with all receipts filed
verify: Open the case and confirm receipts and the reconciliation are attached
Pass when no tranche remains open and all receipts are filed

generic.Defined scope/population: All participants, beneficiaries and alternate payees affected by the plan blackout period
generic.In-scope period: The 30 to 60 day advance window before the blackout start date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: The notice carries blackout start date, end date, reason and the allocation review statement
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Distribution count equals affected participants plus beneficiaries and alternate payees
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Mail-house delivery confirmation and e-delivery bounce report retained with the mail date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Undelivered notices are logged with a corrected address and a re-issue date
generic.Test population: The full affected population extract used to generate the blackout notice mailing
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires the mail date to fall 30 to 60 days before the blackout start date
generic.Exception handling path: Bounces and returned mail route to address remediation and immediate re-issue
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the notice content, timing and recipient count all satisfy the requirement
generic.Evidence location: Plan record in the document management repository with delivery files attached

steps.title: Build the affected population extract for the blackout notice
sop: Extract all participants with a balance plus beneficiaries and alternate payees
Confirm terminated participants with balances are included in the extract
Attach the extract with its record count to the installation case
Done when the affected population extract is produced and attached
verify: Check the extract includes beneficiaries and alternate payees, not only actives
Pass when the extract covers every affected party with a recorded count

steps.title: Confirm the notice states blackout start and end dates and the reason
sop: Read the drafted notice against the required content elements
Confirm the start date, end date and the reason for the blackout are stated
Confirm the affected transactions are described
Done when the notice content is confirmed complete
verify: Compare notice content to the required content checklist
Pass when start date, end date, reason and affected transactions are all present

steps.title: Confirm the investment allocation review statement is included
sop: Locate the statement advising participants to evaluate their allocations
Confirm the wording matches the approved template version
Record the template version used on the installation case
Done when the allocation statement is confirmed present and on-template
verify: Check the notice against the approved template version
Pass when the allocation review statement appears in the approved wording

steps.title: Verify the mail date falls 30 to 60 days before the blackout start
sop: Confirm the planned mail date from the mail-house schedule
Count business days between the mail date and the blackout start date
Reschedule the mailing if the window is not satisfied
Done when the mail date sits inside the 30 to 60 day window
verify: Recompute the interval between mail date and blackout start date
Pass when the mail date is 30 to 60 days before the blackout start date

steps.title: Distribute the notice to the full affected population
sop: Release the notice file to the mail house and to electronic delivery
Post the notice to the participant portal document vault on the mail date
Record the distribution count and channel split on the case
Done when the notice is distributed across both channels
verify: Compare the distributed count to the affected population extract count
Pass when the distribution count equals the affected population count

steps.title: File the mail-house delivery confirmation and bounce report on the plan record
sop: Collect the mail-house delivery confirmation file after the run
Collect the electronic delivery bounce report and returned-mail file
Index both to the plan record in the document management repository
Done when both delivery files are filed against the plan record
verify: Open the plan record and confirm both delivery files are present
Pass when the delivery confirmation and bounce report are both filed

steps.title: Work bounces and returned mail to re-issue
sop: Identify participants with a bounce or returned-mail outcome
Obtain a corrected address from the sponsor payroll record
Re-issue the notice and record the re-issue date on the case
Done when every failed delivery has a re-issue or a logged exhaustion
verify: Review the failed delivery list for items without a re-issue date
Pass when every failed delivery carries a re-issue or documented exhaustion

generic.Defined scope/population: Every fund and target-date series to be loaded onto the recordkeeping platform for the plan
generic.In-scope period: From confirmed lineup sign-off to the platform lineup go-live date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each fund has ticker, CUSIP, asset class, pricing frequency and trade cutoff time recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Loaded fund count equals the confirmed sponsor-approved lineup fund count
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Fund setup extract and test election results retained with the configuration date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Funds failing a test election are logged with the cause and the fix applied
generic.Test population: All funds loaded to the plan lineup on the policy administration system
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires exactly one fund or target-date series flagged as the plan QDIA
generic.Exception handling path: Missing prospectus or failed test elections block lineup go-live until resolved
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when every lineup fund accepts a test buy and sell and holds a current prospectus
generic.Evidence location: Fund records in the policy administration system and the plan folder in the document repository

steps.title: Load each fund with its static data onto the policy administration system
sop: Create a fund record with ticker, CUSIP, asset class and pricing frequency
Set the fund trade cutoff time used for same-day NAV pricing
Attach the fund to the plan lineup with its effective date
Done when every confirmed fund exists as a plan lineup record
verify: Compare the loaded fund count to the confirmed lineup count
Pass when every confirmed fund exists with complete static data

steps.title: Flag the QDIA fund or target-date series and set default mapping
sop: Set the QDIA flag on the designated fund or target-date series
Configure the default mapping by participant birth year for a target-date series
Confirm no second fund carries the QDIA flag
Done when the QDIA designation and mapping are saved
verify: Query the plan lineup for records carrying the QDIA flag
Pass when exactly one fund or target-date series is flagged as the plan QDIA

steps.title: Set fund-level trading restrictions on the platform
sop: Apply the excessive trading policy parameters to each affected fund
Apply the equity wash restriction on the stable value option
Record the restriction basis against each fund record
Done when trading restrictions are configured on every affected fund
verify: Review each restricted fund record for the configured restriction
Pass when every fund requiring a restriction has it configured and dated

steps.title: Attach the current prospectus and fact sheet to each fund record
sop: Collect the current prospectus and fact sheet for each lineup fund
Load each document to the document management repository and link it to the fund
Record the document date so staleness can be monitored later
Done when every fund record links to a current prospectus and fact sheet
verify: Filter the lineup for funds with no linked prospectus
Pass when no lineup fund is missing a current prospectus

steps.title: Run a test election against every fund to confirm buy and sell acceptance
sop: Place a test buy and a test sell against each lineup fund in the test path
Confirm each trade accepts and prices at the expected NAV
Log any fund that rejects a trade with the error returned
Done when every fund has been tested for buy and sell activity
verify: Review the test results for funds with a rejected trade
Pass when every lineup fund accepted both a test buy and a test sell

steps.title: Clear failed test elections and re-test the affected funds
sop: Diagnose each rejected test election against the fund setup fields
Correct the setup and re-run the test election for that fund
Record the cause and fix on the installation case
Done when every previously failing fund passes the test election
verify: Re-run the test election results extract
Pass when no lineup fund shows an outstanding test election failure

steps.title: Publish the lineup and file the configuration evidence
sop: Set the lineup live for the plan effective date on the platform
